description:
Permanently delete a Sentry Alert (notification workflow) and its notifications for every connected project and monitor. Connected monitors are kept.
To stop one source or pause it, use update_alert_rule. Metric Monitors are deleted with delete_metric_monitor.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.
The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

ruleId.description: Alert workflow ID from get_alert_rule with `issue`. Metric Monitor and legacy metric alert IDs are not workflow IDs.

name: delete_alert_rule
title: Delete Alert Rule
